config_name: Gigabyte A18 3VH — Ryzen 7 260 / RTX 5060, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD (+1TB drive dock bundle)

specs.ports: USB-C, USB-A x2-3, HDMI, Ethernet, 3.5mm (exact set unverified)

battery.notes: ~76Wh est.; large chassis but modest GPU. ~5-6h light use est.

price.notes: BBY API-verified 2026-11-24, SKU 19956028 reg $3,498.57 / sale $2,449. Marketplace DOCK-BUNDLE SET (laptop + 1TB drive/dock) — third-party fulfillment/return risk, inflated 'reg' anchor. Only 18-inch Gigabyte stocked in CA.

praises: Big 18-inch 165Hz WQXGA screen for ~$2,449 sale — cheapest 18-inch gaming laptop tier at BBY CA
Includes extra 1TB drive/dock in the bundle set
Efficient Ryzen 7 + RTX 5060 combo runs cool and quiet at light loads
32GB RAM standard; SO-DIMM/dual-M.2 upgradeability expected from the Gigabyte platform
Full-size deck with numpad for the big chassis
complaints: No professional review of the A18 3VH exists — ports, TGP, and panel specs unverified
Marketplace dock-bundle with inflated 'regular' price and third-party returns
Ryzen 7 260 is a rebadged mid-range mobile chip, not HX-class
RTX 5060 on an 18-inch panel is modest GPU for the screen size
Plastic chassis quality consistent with the budget Gaming line, not a premium 18-inch

design_philosophy: The A18 3VH stretches Gigabyte's value playbook to 18 inches: a big matte 165Hz WQXGA panel on an efficient mid-range AMD + RTX 5060 platform, sold in Canada only as a discounted marketplace dock-bundle. Screen size per dollar is the entire pitch; CPU tier, materials, and GPU headroom are where the money was saved.
rating_notes: No pro numeric score found (honest null). Ratings inferred from NBC Gaming A16 GA6H review (80%) with 18-inch deltas: screen_size +1.0, portability -2.0 (est. 2.8kg), thermals +1.0 (bigger chassis, modest GPU). RTX 5060 parity with the Gaming A16 5060 tier. Many specs (ports, weight, battery) estimated and disclosed; A18 platform documentation is thin.
standouts: Cheapest 18-inch gaming laptop tier at BBY CA ($2,449 sale)
dealbreakers: Modest RTX 5060 GPU for a large 18-inch panel
Marketplace dock-bundle: third-party fulfillment, inflated anchor
